question: Which of the following ministries was responsible for governing ‘Indira Awaas Yojana’?

options.text: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

solution:
The correct answer is the __**Ministry of Rural Development**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Ministry of Rural Development is responsible for governing the Indira Awaas Yojana (IAY**)
 
• The** IAY was launched in 1985 by Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi. **
 
• The** IAY is a flagship program of the Ministry of Rural Development that aims to reduce poverty and provide housing for the rural poor.** 
 
• The **IAY is a sub-scheme of the Rural Landless Employment Guarantee Programme (RLEGP). **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Rural Developmen**t

 
 
• Focuses **on rural development through programs such as grants for health and education, affordable housing, and public work programs. **
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Human Resource Development**
 
 
• Includes the Department of Higher Education and the Department of School Education & Literacy. 
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment**
 
 
• Works for the welfare of marginalized and disadvantaged groups, including people with disabilities, senior citizens, and victims of drug abuse. 
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Labour and Employment**
 
 
• Works to ensure the welfare of workers in the unorganized sector, including weavers, fishermen, and construction workers.
